svg.aria-label: backends(): from 10 to 800 users in a week with zero downtime — the backend of an AI stock-analysis agent. infra(): mean time to first response cut by over 90% with a self-healing Kubernetes operator across 75+ services. agents(): up to +10 percentage points for open-source Qwen models on AndroidWorld and MobileWorld, trained on trajectories from my agent harness.
